title: Standby power loads in Group R-2 occupancies.
officialText:
Group R-2 occupancies in buildings greater than 125 feet (38 100
mm) in height shall be required to provide a standby power system to support the following loads:
1. Power and lighting for fire command center required by Section 403.4.5;
2. Ventilation and automatic fire detection equipment for smokeproof enclosures;
3. At least one elevator serving all floors, or one elevator per bank where different banks serve different portions of the
building; and
4. Stair pressurization systems when provided.
